CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=<definer> SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `dbcc_it_cat`.`v_items` AS select `dbcc_it_cat`.`items`.`id` AS `id`,`dbcc_it_cat`.`items`.`code` AS `code`,(`dbcc_it_cat`.`items`.`price` * `dbcc_it_cat`.`items`.`qty`) AS `amount` from `dbcc_it_cat`.`items` where (`dbcc_it_cat`.`items`.`status` <> 'new')
